about: Machine spec merge rules, shared by the server (crates/boxd-core/src/machine_spec.rs) and both SDKs (sdk/typescript/tests/spec.test.ts, sdk/python/tests/test_spec.py). Each case merges `pieces` in order and expects either the resolved spec (`expect`, in the stored JSON form: empty fields left out, version defaulted to 1) or the exact error message (`error`). Change the rules in all three places together.

one piece passes through and gets the version
an explicit version is kept
maps merge and the later piece wins
a later connection replaces an earlier one for the same toolkit
lists combine in order without duplicates
secrets combine in order without duplicates
packages combine in order without duplicates
packages are commands, kept as written
isolated only turns on
isolated false is left out
the same base and size twice is fine
empty maps and lists are left out
a full spec
two different bases
